# AWS Global Accelerator

Store standard accelerators, listeners and regional endpoint groups with local endpoint validation, CloudFormation and Terraform support; no traffic forwarding.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Service ID | `globalaccelerator` |
| Signing name | `globalaccelerator` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2018-08-08` |
| Scope | Account-wide |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 22 of 56 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-global-accelerator) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: static documentation IPs and DNS names do not resolve or forward traffic; no anycast networking, listener sockets, endpoint probing, flow-log delivery or data plane.
- Custom routing accelerators/listeners/groups, cross-account attachments/endpoints, and BYOIP lifecycle operations are not whitelisted; CreateAccelerator.IpAddresses and endpoint AttachmentArn fail explicitly as unsupported inputs. Terraform provider v5.100.0 unconditionally requests unsupported ListCrossAccountResources for ARN endpoints, even same-account load balancers; the Terraform case uses an Elastic IP endpoint to avoid that unsupported API.
- Accelerator event history, AWS deployment timing and AWS network-zone topology are not simulated; network zone labels zone-1 and zone-2 are local fixtures.
- Client IP preservation and endpoint compatibility settings are stored; no packets, routing policies, security-group reachability or load balancer TLS traffic behavior is executed.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
